description: This file defines the SessionCookieJar class, which extends CookieJar to add functionality for persisting cookies in a client session. It includes methods for saving and loading cookies to/from session storage, managing session cookies, and ensuring data consistency.

classes.name: SessionCookieJar
classes.description: A class for managing cookies that are persisted in the client session, allowing cookies to be saved and loaded across different requests within the same session.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session cookie jar with a session key and an optional flag to store session cookies.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that saves cookies to the session when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes cookies and stores them into the PHP session under the specified session key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads cookies from the PHP session into the cookie jar, validating and deserializing stored cookie data.
